notes: Fewer, bigger enemies: past threat 4 the horde grows in size instead of numbers (a big one is worth several small ones in souls, kills and threat), so phones stay smoother. Bosses are huge and keep up with strong builds, with a short breather when they enrage. Tempest and Mortar shells hit softer. Allies level up their weapons as you pick upgrades. Oil Slick and Spike Trail are much stronger, and auto-pick keeps some defense.
